test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian states has the lowest population density as per Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Arunachal Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the Census 2011, Arunachal Pradesh has the lowest population density among all the Indian states.
 
• The population density of Arunachal Pradesh is 17 people per square kilometer.
 
• Sikkim, Nagaland, and Mizoram have population densities of 86, 119, and 52 people per square kilometer respectively.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is located in the northeastern part of India and shares its borders with Bhutan, China, and Myanmar.
 
• The state is known for its diverse tribal culture, scenic beauty, and rich biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** on population data from the **2011 Census of India** for the states 

 
• **Uttarakhand**: 10,086,292
 
• **Jharkhand**: 32,988,134
 
• **Mizoram**: 1,097,206
